student_answer: RSA is a public key encryption technique where two keys are used. One key encrypts the data and the private key decrypts it. It is based on prime numbers.
RSA uses keys to make things secure.
Deadlock happens when two or more processes are stuck waiting for each other to release resources, so none of them can finish execution.
Deadlock is when the computer freezes up and runs out of memory.
MVC separates an application into three components: the model for data, the view for the user interface, and the controller that handles user input and logic.
MVC stands for model view controller and helps write code faster.
